references.text: The verses describe different phases of the same event; 34:13 explains the cunning strategy that led to the plundering in 34:27.
The verses show a chronological connection within the same account: from receiving news (v.5) to acts of vengeance (v.27).
The verses link cause (grief and shock in v.7) directly to effect (plundering and killing in v.27).
Connects two violent events at 'Shechem' where brothers/family members were killed; shows a repetition of the shame of violence tied to this place.
